name: aicte-workflow-sih26262
description: Integrated AICTE Approval Workflow Automation, Compliance Monitoring and Alert Management System (SIH 26262)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix server run db:push && npm --prefix server run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client exec tsc -b --noEmit
